steps.do: Find every personal checking account that passes all four checks. (1) Tenure: the referrer's tenure meets the account's minimum (Light Green 14 days; Blue, Green, Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Gold Years 30; Dark Green, Evergreen, Purple 45; Bluest 60). (2) Deposit: the planned new-money deposit meets the account's qualifying deposit (Light Green $100, Green Fee-Free $300, Blue/Green/Light Blue $500, Evergreen $750, Dark Green/Purple/Gold Years $1,000, Bluest $2,000), and for Bluest also its $75,000 opening deposit. (3) Age: the referred person's age fits (Light Green 13-24, Dark Green 17-26, Gold Years 62+, all others 18+). (4) Cap: this year's referrals of that type are below its annual cap. The account types the referrer holds do not matter. Among the accounts that pass, recommend the one with the highest referrer + referred bonus, and state both amounts.

Drop Sky Blue unless the business is within 4 years of formation. The account types the referrer already holds do not matter. Recommend the program with the highest referrer bonus.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, or told they could not be verified. Their referral history and account tenure have been checked from the records. Then one of two outcomes holds. (a) The customer was told the referral cannot be submitted now and why: rolling window full, tenure too short, same registered address, referred party not new or same business owner, signer under 18, or no program's deposit or age rule met. No recommendation was given and nothing was submitted. (b) The customer was told the eligible account to use (personal: highest combined bonus; business: highest referrer bonus), with both bonus amounts, the qualifying deposit and its window, and the conditions. They have submitted submit_referral with that account type ending in 'Account' (or know to do so), and the result has been explained.

open_questions: The rolling window counts 'referral bonuses' by timestamp. The documents do not say whether pending referrals (NO_PROGRESS, APPLIED, IN_PROGRESS) or REJECTED ones count toward the 2.
The fields that get_referrals_by_user returns (timestamp, account type, status) are not documented.
No document names submit_referral or its account_type format. The workflow uses the product's full name ending in 'Account'.
No document breaks ties between products with equal combined bonuses (Bluest and Gold Years at $125; Green and Light Blue at $50).
The documents do not say whether annual caps count per product or across all products. The workflow counts them per product type in the current calendar year.

when.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements. This document covers the general terms and restrictions that apply to all checking account referral programs.

starts.note: customer: only when the customer asks to refer someone, or asks which account to refer someone to. The agent never offers a referral and never submits one. The customer submits it with their own submit_referral tool.
starts.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first, as users who are not eligible to submit referrals while being given recommendations by the agent tend to leave dissatisfactory reviews.

tools.not_used: Not part of this job. An ineligible referral is explained to the customer and the job stops there. Transfer only under the general policy: the customer asks for a human 4 times, or a tool keeps returning errors and the customer agrees to a transfer.

info.about: Any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number or address, to verify the customer
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: Where the referred person is registered to live. A referral is ineligible if this matches the referrer's address on file. A nickname such as 'roommate' does not prove a shared address, so ask.
info.ask: Does the person you want to refer live at the same address as you? If not, what address is she or he registered at?

info.about: Age of the referred person. Must be 18 or older, except Light Green (13–24, minors with a guardian). Also decides eligibility for Dark Green (17–26) and Gold Years (62+).
info.ask: How old is the person you'd like to refer?

info.about: Whether the referred person has any open Rho-Bank checking or savings account, or closed one within the past 12 months
info.ask: Has the person you're referring ever had a Rho-Bank checking or savings account, including one closed in the past 12 months?

info.about: How much new money (not a transfer from another Rho-Bank account) the referred person expects to deposit, and how soon. This sets which programs' qualifying deposits she or he can meet.
info.ask: About how much new money will the person you're referring deposit into the new account, and within roughly how many days of opening it?

info.about: Referrer's checking accounts and their date_opened; the earliest gives tenure
Referrals the referrer already made, with timestamps, account types and statuses

steps.do: Greet the customer. Before discussing any referral details, ask for their name and any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address.
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record using the name (case sensitive), the email or the user id they gave.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email with the email they gave, or get_user_information_by_id)

steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Compare the values the customer gave with the record. Verified only if at least 2 of date of birth, email, phone and address match. If fewer match, say you cannot verify them and share nothing; do not continue.
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Get the current timestamp. It is used for the verification log, the 9-day rolling window and tenure.
steps.if: identity verified
steps.quote: A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.if: identity verified in check_identity
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Read every referral the verified user has made.
steps.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first, as users who are not eligible to submit referrals while being given recommendations by the agent tend to leave dissatisfactory reviews.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve the verified user's bank accounts (account_type, account_class, status, date_opened).
steps.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

steps.do: From get_referrals, count the referrals (any account type, excluding REJECTED or ERROR) whose timestamps fall within the 9 days before the get_time timestamp. If the count is 2 or more, a new referral would be automatically denied. In that case, tell the customer they cannot submit a referral now and must wait until their oldest of those referrals is more than 9 days old. Give no account recommendation or bonus terms, do not have them submit, and stop.
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.do: If the customer has not already said them, ask about the referred person: registered address (or whether they live at the same address), age, any current Rho-Bank account or one closed in the past 12 months, and expected new-money deposit amount and timing.
steps.if: rolling window check passed
steps.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

steps.do: Compare the referred person's address with the verified user's address from lookup_user. If they are the same, or if the referred person has a current Rho-Bank account or one closed within the past 12 months, explain that the referral would be rejected and stop with no recommendation. If the referred person is under 18, only Light Green (ages 13–24, minor with a guardian) remains possible.
steps.if: rolling window check passed
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Find the earliest date_opened among the user's checking accounts in get_accounts, then the days from that date to the get_time date. For each product, keep it only if (a) that tenure is at least the product's referrer tenure (Light Green 14 days; Blue, Green, Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Gold Years 30; Dark Green, Evergreen, Purple 45; Bluest 60) and (b) the user's referrals for that account type this calendar year (get_referrals) are below that product's annual cap. If no checking account exists, or no product passes, explain why and stop.
steps.if: referred person checks passed
steps.quote: Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

steps.do: Of the products left after check_tenure_and_caps, also drop any whose age rule (Light Green 13–24, Dark Green 17–26, Gold Years 62+) or qualifying deposit or opening deposit (Bluest $75,000 to open) the referred person cannot meet, using ask_referred_person_facts. Recommend the remaining product with the highest combined bonus (referrer bonus plus referred bonus). State both amounts, the qualifying deposit and its deadline, and that the deposit must be new money kept in the account for 30 days after the qualifying period. Mention the 90-day clawback and that the bonus cannot be combined with other promotions.
steps.if: at least one product passes every check
steps.quote: The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.

steps.do: The customer submits the referral with their own user_id and the recommended account's full name, ending in 'Account' (for example 'Blue Account'). The agent tells them these values and does not submit the referral for them.

args.account_type: the account recommended in recommend_account, full product name

steps.if: customer chooses to submit after the recommendation
steps.quote: Only one referral code can be applied per new account.

steps.do: If the submission returns REJECTED, explain the likely reason (rolling window, prior account, same address) and do not retry right away. If it returns ERROR, ask them to try again later. Otherwise confirm the referral is recorded and remind them what the referred person must do.
steps.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the rolling window limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.

rules.rule: Check eligibility (rolling window, address, referred-person status, tenure) before giving any recommendation or referral terms. If ineligible, explain and stop without recommending.
rules.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first, as users who are not eligible to submit referrals while being given recommendations by the agent tend to leave dissatisfactory reviews.

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, across all checking account types. A third is auto-denied.
rules.quote: You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

rules.rule: The window counts across all checking products.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

rules.rule: After a rolling-window denial, the customer may refer again once their oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.
rules.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

rules.rule: The referred person must have no existing checking or savings account, and none closed within the past 12 months.
rules.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

rules.rule: The referrer and the referred person must not be registered at the same address.
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referred person must be 18 or older, except for Light Green.
rules.quote: The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.

rules.rule: Tenure is measured from the earliest checking account's date_opened, whatever account type the referrer holds now.
rules.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

rules.rule: The qualifying deposit must be new money, must stay 30 days after the qualifying period, and is clawed back if the account closes within 90 days.
rules.quote: The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.

rules.rule: Clawback if the referred account closes within 90 days.
rules.quote: If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed (clawback provision).

rules.rule: No stacking with other promotions.
rules.quote: The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.

rules.rule: Blue Account: referrer $35 + referred $30 = $65 combined.
rules.quote: Yes. When you refer someone to open a Blue Account, you earn $35 for each successful referral. The person you refer receives $30 as a welcome bonus.

rules.rule: Blue Account: deposit ≥ $500 within 60 days; tenure ≥ 30 days.
rules.quote: The referred person must deposit at least $500 within 60 days of opening their account. A minimum banking relationship of 30 days is required to participate—this is measured from when you first opened any checking account with us.

rules.rule: Blue Account: annual cap 5.
rules.quote: Yes. You can earn up to 5 referral bonuses per calendar year.

rules.rule: Bluest Account: referrer $75 (+ referred $50 = $125 combined).
rules.quote: Referrer bonus: $75 per successful referral

rules.rule: Bluest Account: referred bonus $50.
rules.quote: New member bonus: $50 for the person you refer

rules.rule: Bluest Account: deposit $2,000 within 90 days.
rules.quote: Qualifying requirement: Referred person must deposit $2,000 within 90 days

rules.rule: Bluest Account: tenure ≥ 60 days.
rules.quote: Eligibility: Referrers must have established their Rho-Bank checking relationship at least 60 days prior.

rules.rule: Bluest Account: annual cap 8.
rules.quote: Annual limit: 8 referral bonuses per calendar year

rules.rule: Bluest Account: the referred person needs $75,000 to open, so recommend it only if they can deposit that.
rules.quote: Deposit at least $75,000 to open your account.

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: referrer $40 (+ referred $30 = $70 combined).
rules.quote: $40 for each qualifying referral

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: referred bonus $30.
rules.quote: $30 welcome bonus

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: tenure ≥ 45 days.
rules.quote: You must satisfy the 45-day minimum as a Rho-Bank checking customer.

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: deposit ≥ $1,000 within 60 days.
rules.quote: They must deposit at least $1,000 within 60 days of opening

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: annual cap 6.
rules.quote: 6 referral bonuses

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: referred person must be 17 to 26.
rules.quote: The primary account holder must be at least 17.

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: maximum age 26.
rules.quote: You can maintain the account through 26.

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: referrer $35 (+ referred $25 = $60 combined); annual cap 6.
rules.quote: Refer others to join Evergreen and earn $35 per successful referral

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: referred bonus $25.
rules.quote: New members receive $25 as a welcome bonus

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: annual cap 6.

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: tenure ≥ 45 days.
rules.quote: The 45-day tenure threshold applies—calculated from the date you opened your first Rho-Bank checking account.

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: deposit $750 within 60 days.
rules.quote: The referred person must deposit $750 within 60 days of account opening to trigger the referral bonus.

rules.rule: Gold Years Account: referrer $50 (+ referred $75 = $125 combined).
rules.quote: $50 for each successful referral

rules.rule: Gold Years Account: referred bonus $75.
rules.quote: $75 as a welcome bonus

rules.rule: Gold Years Account: tenure ≥ 30 days.
rules.quote: The referrer must have maintained checking account status with Rho-Bank for 30 days.

rules.rule: Gold Years Account: referred person must be 62 or older.
rules.quote: The person you refer must be eligible for a Gold Years Account (age 62+)

rules.rule: Gold Years Account: deposit $1,000 within 90 days; annual cap 6.
rules.quote: They must deposit $1,000 within 90 days of account opening

rules.rule: Green Account (checking): referrer $20 (+ referred $30 = $50 combined).
rules.quote: You earn: $20 per successful referral

rules.rule: Green Account (checking): referred bonus $30.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: referrer $20 (+ referred $35 = $55 combined).
rules.quote: Your reward: $20 per successful referral

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: referred bonus $35.
rules.quote: New member reward: $35 welcome bonus

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: annual cap 4.
rules.quote: Annual limit: 4 referrals per year

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: deposit ≥ $300 within 60 days.

rules.rule: Light Blue Account: referrer $30 (+ referred $20 = $50 combined).
rules.quote: Referral bonus: $30 for each successful referral

rules.quote: Welcome bonus: $20 when they open and fund their account

rules.rule: Light Blue Account: deposit ≥ $500 within 60 days.

draft.done_when: One of two outcomes. (1) The customer was told why a referral would be denied (rolling window, same address, referred person not new, tenure, or no eligible product), with no recommendation given and no submission. (2) The agent recommended the eligible product with the highest combined bonus, stated both bonus amounts and the deposit conditions, and the customer either ran submit_referral with their user_id and that account's full name or chose not to.
